example: compiles
# ACE-Step generation stays on the configured server; effects after the existing take can preview locally.
composition "ACE music hybrid preview" { ample 1  tempo 96  master-seed 20261017 }

settings { acestep.backend server }

lyrics words {
  lang en
  timing per-line
  file lyrics/preview.lyr
}

mood-scene scene {
  direction Warm, restrained singer-songwriter pop; felt piano, muted bass, soft strings, intimate vocal, steady 96 BPM.
}

ace-music song at 1 for 8 {
  music_direction A complete warm pop ballad with gentle piano, muted bass, brushed percussion and soft strings; keep the lead intimate, maintain a steady pulse, and avoid abrupt arrangement changes.
  steps 50
  guidance 7
  shift 1
  solver euler
  lm_temperature 0.85
  lm_cfg_scale 2
  lm_top_p 0.9
  lm_top_k 0
  lm_seed 2026101701
  seed 2026101702
  from words.words -> lyrics
  from scene.style -> style
}

chorus local_width {
  depth 5 ms
  period 1500 ms
  mix 25 %
  from song.audio -> audio
}

master output {
  from local_width.audio -> audio
}

Arpeggiator arpeggiator

Turns chords into runs of single notes, one after the other, at a rate you choose (for example 1/16). It takes notes between a clip and an instrument and gives notes back.

version 1.0 MIDI effects provisional since 1.0

NameTypeRequired

Parameters

NameTypeDefault

Example

example: compiles
composition "Arpeggiator preview" { ample 1  tempo 96  master-seed 17 }

midi-clip phrase {
  chords C Am F G
  bars 4
}

  rate 1/16
  pattern updown
  octaves 2
  gate 75

Autotune autotune

Pulls a voice (one singer, or one monophonic instrument) to the right notes. Cuts a recording into slices (the words of a spoken phrase, found by following the level, or start times you give) and puts them back on the beat in the order of a pattern: 1 2 3 4 3 4*2 plays the four slices on the grid, - is a rest and 4*2 repeats a slice twice inside its step (a stutter). Use it on a spoken line, then through a vocoder, for a rhythmic robot voice.

version 1.0 Effects provisional since 1.0

Inputs

NameTypeRequired
audioaudioyes

Outputs

NameType
audioaudio

Parameters

NameTypeDefault
slicestextauto
sensitivitytext50 %
gaptext150 ms
patterntext
steptext1
gatetext90 %
fittext0 %
repeattext1

Example

example: compiles
composition "Chop a voice" { ample 1  tempo 84  master-seed 43 }

midi-clip chant at 1 for 4 {
  bars 4
  notes 1:0:2:57:92 1:2:2:60:96 2:0:3:64:104 3:0:4:60:100 4:0:2:57:92 4:2:2:55:90
}

delay-llama llama {
  vowel auto(1:100, 3:30, 5:0)
  mouth auto(1:15, 3:85, 5:40)
  voice 40
  glide 120 ms
  echo 0%
  gain -4 dB
  from chant.notes -> notes
}

chop chopped {
  slices 0 2.9 5.7 8.6 11.4 14.3 17.1 20
  pattern "1 3 - 2 4*2 - 3 1"
  step 1
  from llama.audio -> audio
}

master output {
  from chopped.audio -> audio
}

Delay Llama delay-llama

A singing voice made of formants (FOF synthesis), in the spirit of the classic Delay Lama: notes in, a chanting, humming, oohing and aahing voice out. Vowel, voice (the size of the singer) and mouth can be curves over the song; glide slides between notes that touch, vibrato wobbles, unison stacks detuned voices, echo adds the classic stereo echo. General MIDI gm

Plays the notes it receives with a General MIDI program (bank and program number) from a SoundFont 2 file of the project. Compact notes support per-note pan, fine pitch, release, cutoff and slide without a second attack. It needs a SoundFont file and gives audio, and on send the part of every note that the SoundFont and controller 91 send to a reverb (silent when nothing is sent): connect it to a reverb of the song. chorus is the same for the chorus send (generator 15 and controller 93).

Send bus send

Sends a part of up to four sounds to a shared effect: through is the plain sum, send the sum with a send level per input.

version 1.0 Mix provisional since 1.0

Inputs

NameTypeRequired
audio1audiono
audio2audiono
audio3audiono
audio4audiono

Outputs

NameType
throughaudio
sendaudio

NameTypeDefault
levelstext-12 -12 -12 -12
channelstextauto

Example

example: compiles
composition "Send preview" { ample 1  tempo 96  master-seed 20261017 }

midi-clip phrase {
  chords C Am F G
  bars 4
}

synth part_a {
  wave triangle
  gain -9 dB
  from phrase.notes -> notes
}

synth part_b {
  wave saw
  gain -15 dB
  from phrase.notes -> notes
}

send fx_send {
  levels -6 -12
  from part_a.audio -> audio1
  from part_b.audio -> audio2

mixer blend {
  from fx_send.through -> audio1
  from room.audio -> audio2
}

master master {
  from blend.audio -> audio
}

Sequencer sequencer

An advanced block: channels, patterns and a playlist from a .ampleseq file or kept in the song, mixed into one output and into up to eight lanes that name the channels they carry. It can read a sequence file and gives audio.

version 1.0 Advanced provisional since 1.0

Needs

  • Optionally a .ampleseq file (parameter file); the sequence can also be kept in the song.

sound source This block makes a sound by itself, so its example can be rendered and heard.

Inputs

None.

Outputs

NameType
audioaudio
lane1audio
lane2audio
lane3audio
lane4audio
lane5audio
lane6audio
lane7audio
lane8audio

Parameters

NameTypeDefault
filetext
lanestext
gaintext0 dB
sequencetext
channelstextauto

Example

example: compiles
composition "Local sequencer preview" { ample 1  tempo 104  master-seed 5 }

sequencer sq at 1 for 8 {
  lanes lane1=bass lane2=lead
  sequence {
    sequencer 1
    channel bass bass vol=-6
    channel lead notes wave=triangle vol=-10
    pattern verse bars=2
      bass 1:0:1:45:100 1:2:1:45:90 2:0:1:43:100 2:2:1:43:90
      lead 1:0:1:69:96 1:1:1:72:96 1:2:2:76:96 2:0:2:74:96
    pattern chorus bars=2
      bass 1:0:2:41:100 2:0:2:48:100
      lead 1:0:1:77:100 1:1:1:76:96 1:2:2:72:96 2:0:2:69:96
    playlist
      clip verse track=1 at=1 for=4
      clip chorus track=1 at=5 for=4
  }
}

reverb space {
  from sq.lane2 -> audio
  mix 25
}

mixer mix {
  from sq.lane1 -> audio1
  from space.audio -> audio2
}

master master bake {
  from mix.audio -> audio
}

Moves the level of the sound (tremolo) or its place between left and right (autopan), at a rate in Hz or locked to the tempo; with shape gate and a step pattern it is a trance gate that cuts a steady pad into rhythm.

version 1.0 Effects provisional since 1.0

Trim (cut the silence) trim

Finds where the sound of a recording really is and cuts the silence before and after it, so a car that passes in a long recording starts at its first sound. When the recording holds several stretches of sound it says so and uses the first, the last, or everything from the start of the first to the end of the last.

version 1.0 Effects provisional since 1.0

  bars 4
}

  gain -9 dB
  from phrase.notes -> notes
}

master output {

Vocoder vocoder

Makes one sound speak with another: the voice on the modulator input is split into frequency bands and the loudness of every band sets the loudness of the same band of the carrier (a chord, a pad, a saw), so the carrier says the words. Consonants such as s and t come from noise that follows the highest band of the voice. For robot voices and the classic Daft Punk sound.

version 1.0 Effects provisional since 1.0

Inputs

NameTypeRequired
modulatoraudioyes
carrieraudioyes

Outputs

NameType
audioaudio

Parameters

NameTypeDefault
bandstext20
lowtext120 Hz
hightext7500 Hz
attacktext4 ms
releasetext70 ms
widthtext140 %
sibilancetext35 %
shifttext0 st
mixtext100 %
gaintext0 dB

Example

example: compiles
composition "Vocoder" { ample 1  tempo 84  master-seed 41 }

midi-clip chant at 1 for 4 {
  bars 4
  notes 1:0:2:57:92 1:2:2:60:96 2:0:3:64:104 3:0:4:60:100 4:0:2:57:92 4:2:2:55:90
}

delay-llama llama {
  vowel auto(1:100, 3:30, 5:0)
  mouth auto(1:15, 3:85, 5:40)
  voice 40
  glide 120 ms
  echo 0%
  gain -4 dB
  from chant.notes -> notes
}

midi-clip pad-notes at 1 for 4 {
  bars 4
  chords "Am F C G"
}

synth carrier at 1 for 4 {
  wave saw
  cutoff 6000 Hz
  from pad-notes.notes -> notes
}

vocoder robot {
  bands 24
  sibilance 35 %
  from llama.audio -> modulator
  from carrier.audio -> carrier
}

master output {
  from robot.audio -> audio
}

AMP2020 An effect has active audio and render inputs

error static since 1.0

An effect consumes existing audio through in or an isolated source render recipe through render_in. Both connections may be present when at least one is disabled.

Wrong

example: AMP2020
eq tone { from drums.audio -> audio  from drums.render -> render }

Right

eq tone { from drums.audio -> audio  from drums.render -> render disabled }

AMP1001 Missing composition line

error static since 1.0

Every song starts with a composition line that names it and sets the tempo and the master seed. It can also say which AMPLE version the song was written for (ample 1).

Wrong

example: AMP1001
features { lyrics on }

Right

composition "my-song" { tempo 92  master-seed 424242 }

AMP1002 Tempo out of range

error static since 1.0

The tempo must be between 20 and 300 beats per minute.

Wrong

example: AMP1002
composition "x" { tempo 999  master-seed 1 }

Right

composition "x" { tempo 120  master-seed 1 }

AMP1003 Malformed composition line

error static since 1.0

The composition line has a fixed shape: a quoted name, then in braces an optional AMPLE version (ample 1), the tempo and the master-seed.

Wrong

example: AMP1003
project my-song tempo 92

Right

composition "my-song" { tempo 92  master-seed 424242 }

AMP1004 Unknown module

error static since 1.0

features lists the opt-in modules: quality, credits, signing, secrets, lyrics, git-mirror.

Wrong

example: AMP1004
features { qualty on }

Right

features { quality on }

AMP1005 Module value

error static since 1.0

A module is either on or off.

Wrong

example: AMP1005
features { quality maybe }

Right

features { quality on }

AMP1006 Assist level

error static since 1.0

assist is one of off, diff, button, auto.

Wrong

example: AMP1006
features { assist always }

Right

features { assist diff }

AMP1007 Unknown lint rule

error static since 1.0

The lint line sets severities for rules that exist (see the Lint rules page).

Wrong

example: AMP1007
lint { L099 error }

Right

lint { L004 error }

AMP1008 Lint level

error static since 1.0

A rule level is off, info, warning or error.

Wrong

example: AMP1008
lint { L004 loud }

Right

lint { L004 error }

AMP1009 Master seed out of range

error static since 1.0

The master seed must be an unsigned 64-bit whole number.

Wrong

example: AMP1009
composition "x" { tempo 120 master-seed 18446744073709551616 }

Right

composition "x" { tempo 120 master-seed 18446744073709551615 }

AMP1100 Unexpected text

error static since 1.0

A line must be a comment, the composition line, a features, lint or layout line, a block header ending with {, or inside a block.

Wrong

example: AMP1100
drums

Right

drums d {
}

AMP1101 Block not closed

error static since 1.0

Every block opened with { must be closed with } on its own line.

Wrong

example: AMP1101
drums d {
  kit kit/tape

Right

drums d {
  kit kit/tape
}

AMP1102 Bad block header

error static since 1.0

A block header has a type and a name: <type> <name> [pinned@<version>] [at ...] [flags] {

Wrong

example: AMP1102
drums {

Right

drums d {

AMP1103 Bad pin

error static since 1.0

Only a pin may follow the name before the placement: pinned@<version>, with dotted numbers (major.minor for a built-in block).

Wrong

example: AMP1103
drums d fixed@1 {

Right

drums d pinned@1.0 {

AMP1104 Bad placement

error static since 1.0

Placement reads: at <bar> for <bars> [as <name>], several separated by commas.

Wrong

example: AMP1104
drums d at 3 {

Right

drums d at 3 for 8 as intro {

AMP1105 Unknown word in header

error static since 1.0

After the name, the pin and the placement only bake, lock, refresh, disabled and freeze seeds|plan are allowed before {.

Wrong

example: AMP1105
drums d freeze {

Right

drums d lock {

AMP1106 Bar number or length

error static since 1.0

Bars start at 1 and a part is at least 1 bar long.

Wrong

example: AMP1106
at 0 for 4

Right

at 1 for 4

AMP1107 Bad from line

error static since 1.0

A connection reads: from <block>.<output> -> <input>.

Wrong

example: AMP1107
from chords -> notes

Right

from chords.notes -> notes

AMP1108 Bad parameter line

error static since 1.0

A parameter is a name followed by its value.

Wrong

example: AMP1108
kit

Right

kit kit/tape

AMP1109 Duplicate parameter

error static since 1.0

A parameter can be given once per block.

Wrong

example: AMP1109
kit a
  kit b

Right

kit a

AMP1110 Bad use line

error static since 1.0

A module instance is written: use <module>[@version] as <name> {

Wrong

example: AMP1110
use groove {

Right

use groove@1.0 as intro {

AMP1112 Settings line

error static since 1.0

The settings line holds plugin settings of this song as pairs of plugin.name and a value, for example settings { acestep.synthModel sft }. Text with spaces goes in quotes.

Wrong

example: AMP1112
settings { synthModel sft }

Right

settings { acestep.synthModel sft }

AMP1113 View kept in comment lines

info static since 1.0

The groups, block sizes and pinned blocks of the canvas used to be kept in comment lines that start with # view. They belong in a view { } block, which is checked like the rest of the song. The quick fix writes the block; saving from the canvas does the same.

Wrong

example: AMP1113
# view pin kick

Right

view {
  pin kick
}

AMP1115 Scratch block of a rewind

error static since 1.0

The scratch block of a rewind block lists its events: at <time> { duration <time>; back <time> }. A time is seconds (6s), milliseconds (500ms) or decimal bars from the start of the block (4.5); back is how far the music jumps back after the scratch (negative: forward).

Wrong

example: AMP1115
rewind r {
  scratch {
    at soon { duration 1s }
  }
}

Right

rewind r {
  scratch {
    at 6s { duration 1.5s; back 0.5s }
  }
}

AMP1114 View block line

error static since 1.0

The view block keeps what the editors remember of the song besides its sound: group <id> { title, member, x, y, label lines }, size <block> <scale>, pin <block>, section "<name>" at <bar> for <bars>, line <block> "<name>" and order <block> .... The song does not depend on it.

Wrong

example: AMP1114
view {
  colour red
}

Right

view {
  pin kick
}

AMP2080 A proposal would widen the policy of the song

error runtime since 1.0

An assistant may only narrow the capabilities and limits of a song, never widen them. A proposal that would give the song a capability it did not have, or raise a limit, is not accepted. Widening is done by the owner, by hand.

Wrong

example: AMP2080
A proposal that adds the capability network to the policy of the song.

Right

A proposal that only removes a capability or lowers a limit.

AMP2081 The parameter is driven by an expression

error runtime since 1.0

The parameter has an expression as its value, so a plain value cannot just replace it. Say what to do with the new value: override (keep the expression and use this value), bake (freeze what the expression gives), literal (drop the expression) or expression (edit the expression).

Wrong

example: AMP2081
Setting block.cutoff to 800 Hz while cutoff is 600 + 3000 * traffic.level, without a mode.

Right

Setting block.cutoff to 800 Hz with the mode literal (the expression is dropped).

AMP2090 Doc comment names a parameter the helper does not have

warning static since 1.0

A @param line of the doc comment of a helper must name one of its parameters. A parameter that was renamed or removed leaves its note behind, and the hover would show a note for something that is not there.

Wrong

example: AMP2090
/**
 * @param dely when it starts
 */
helper up(Notes source, Duration delay) -> Notes { source |> shift(delay) }

Right

/**
 * @param delay when it starts
 */
helper up(Notes source, Duration delay) -> Notes { source |> shift(delay) }

AMP2091 Doc comment says another type than the declaration

warning static since 1.0

The type in a @param or @return line (also a union such as Interval|Int) is documentation, but it must say the same as the declaration; the type aliases of the file are written out first. A comment that promises more or less than the helper does is usually out of date.

Wrong

example: AMP2091
/**
 * @return {Notes|Int} the notes
 */
helper up(Notes source) -> Notes { source }

Right

/**
 * @return {Notes} the notes
 */
helper up(Notes source) -> Notes { source }

AMP2092 Doc comment uses a type that does not exist

warning static since 1.0

A type in a @param or @return line must be a type of the language (Int, Notes, Interval ...) or a type alias of the file. This is usually a typing mistake.

Wrong

example: AMP2092
/**
 * @param {Notess} source the notes
 */
helper up(Notes source) -> Notes { source }

Right

/**
 * @param {Notes} source the notes
 */
helper up(Notes source) -> Notes { source }

AMP2093 Call of a deprecated helper

warning static since 1.0

The doc comment of the helper has an @deprecated tag. Every call of it is reported, so that the callers can move to what the comment points to.

Wrong

example: AMP2093
/**
 * @deprecated use up2
 */
helper up(Notes source) -> Notes { source }

midi-clip a at 1 for 1 {
  notes 1:0:1:60:100 |> up()
}

Right

helper up2(Notes source) -> Notes { source }

midi-clip a at 1 for 1 {
  notes 1:0:1:60:100 |> up2()
}

AMP2094 Doc comment leaves a parameter out

info static since 1.0

The doc comment describes some parameters of the helper but not all. Add a @param line for the others, so that the hover says what each one means.

Wrong

example: AMP2094
/**
 * @param source the notes
 */
helper up(Notes source, Duration delay) -> Notes { source |> shift(delay) }

Right

/**
 * @param source the notes
 * @param delay when it starts
 */
helper up(Notes source, Duration delay) -> Notes { source |> shift(delay) }

AMP2095 A drum grid does not fill whole bars

warning static since 1.0

A drum grid has one character per sixteenth note: 16 steps fill a 4/4 bar (12 in 3/4), a shorter grid repeats inside the bar, a longer grid goes on over the next bars (32 steps are two bars). A grid whose length does not fit (for example 20 steps) starts again in the middle of a bar, so it does not line up with the bar. Write 4, 8, 16, 32 ... steps.

Wrong

example: AMP2095
drums beat at 1 for 4 { pattern kick:x...x...x...x...x... }   (20 steps)

Right

drums beat at 1 for 4 { pattern kick:x...x...x...x... }   (16 steps)

AMP1116 Block comment never closed

error static since 1.0

A comment that starts with /* runs until */. This one is never closed, so everything after it would be a comment. Close it with */, or use # for a comment that ends with the line. A /* inside a string, after a # or right after a letter or digit does not start a comment.

Wrong

example: AMP1116
/* the drums
composition "x" { tempo 100  master-seed 1 }

Right

/* the drums */
composition "x" { tempo 100  master-seed 1 }

AMP1117 Old word for the song line

error static since 1.0

The first line of a song used to start with project. That word also names the folder of songs, so the line starts with composition now. Since v1 the old word is an error; the quick fix (or ample migrate) writes the new word.

Wrong

example: AMP1117
project "x" { tempo 100  master-seed 1 }

Right

composition "x" { tempo 100  master-seed 1 }

AMP1118 No AMPLE version stated

info static since 1.0

The composition line can say which AMPLE version the song was written for (ample 1). Without it the song is read as the current version, so it could read differently after a future change. The quick fix adds the current version; nothing else changes.

Wrong

example: AMP1118
composition "x" { tempo 100  master-seed 1 }

Right

composition "x" { ample 1  tempo 100  master-seed 1 }

AMP1119 Unknown AMPLE version

error static since 1.0

The ample number of a song must be a version this AMPLE reads. A higher number means the song was written for a newer AMPLE and cannot be built here; a song is never changed to a version by itself.

Wrong

example: AMP1119
composition "x" { ample 999  tempo 100  master-seed 1 }

Right

composition "x" { ample 1  tempo 100  master-seed 1 }

AMP1120 Bad meter

error static since 1.0

The meter on the composition line is written as top/bottom: the top number (beats) is 1 to 16 and the bottom number (the note that gets a beat) is 2, 4, 8 or 16. Without a meter a song is in 4/4.

Wrong

example: AMP1120
composition "x" { ample 1  tempo 100  meter 3/5  master-seed 1 }

Right

composition "x" { ample 1  tempo 100  meter 3/4  master-seed 1 }

AMP2251 Control expression not valid

error static since 1.0

A parameter that reads controls is written with numbers (with a unit), + - *, brackets and block.output. This one cannot be read.

Wrong

example: AMP2251
composition "x" { ample 1  tempo 100  master-seed 1 }

filter f {
  cutoff 600 + * traffic.level
}

Right

composition "x" { ample 1  tempo 100  master-seed 1 }

filter f {
  cutoff 600 Hz + 3000 * traffic.level
}

AMP2252 Not a control

error static since 1.0

Only a control (the level of a follow block, a curve or a map) can steer a parameter. This output is audio or something else.

Wrong

example: AMP2252
composition "x" { ample 1  tempo 100  master-seed 1 }

drums d at 1 for 4 {
}
filter f {
  cutoff 600 + 3000 * d.audio
}

Right

composition "x" { ample 1  tempo 100  master-seed 1 }

drums d at 1 for 4 {
}
follow level {
  from d.audio -> audio
}
filter f {
  cutoff 600 + 3000 * level.level
}

AMP2253 Wrong unit for a control

error static since 1.0

A control with a unit (control<Hz>, control<dB>) only steers a parameter in that unit, and a number in an expression must have the unit of the parameter. A control without a unit is scaled to the range of any parameter.

Wrong

example: AMP2253
composition "x" { ample 1  tempo 100  master-seed 1 }

follow level {
  unit dB
}
filter f {
  from level.level -> cutoff
}

Right

composition "x" { ample 1  tempo 100  master-seed 1 }

follow level {
  unit Hz
}
filter f {
  from level.level -> cutoff
}

AMP2254 A parameter has two sources

error static since 1.0

A parameter is steered by a connection (from x.level -> cutoff) or by an expression (cutoff 600 + 3000 * x.level), not by both.

Wrong

example: AMP2254
composition "x" { ample 1  tempo 100  master-seed 1 }

follow level {
}
filter f {
  cutoff 600 + 3000 * level.level
  from level.level -> cutoff
}

Right

composition "x" { ample 1  tempo 100  master-seed 1 }

follow level {
}
filter f {
  cutoff 600 + 3000 * level.level
}

AMP2001 Unknown block type

error static since 1.0

The type must exist in the library (see Block types).

Wrong

example: AMP2001
drumz d pinned@1.2 {

Right

drums d {

AMP2002 Duplicate block name

error static since 1.0

Block names are unique within the song.

Wrong

example: AMP2002
drums a ... {}
  bass a ... {}

Right

drums a ... {}
  bass b ... {}

AMP2003 Unknown parameter

error static since 1.0

A block only accepts the parameters of its type (listed in the hint).

Wrong

example: AMP2003
  patern beat-A

Right

  pattern beat-A

AMP2004 No such block

error static since 1.0

A from line must name a block that exists in the song.

Wrong

example: AMP2004
from chordz.notes -> notes

Right

from chords.notes -> notes

AMP2005 No such output

error static since 1.0

The named output does not exist on that block.

Wrong

example: AMP2005
from chords.note -> notes

Right

from chords.notes -> notes

AMP2006 No such input

error static since 1.0

The named input does not exist on this block.

Wrong

example: AMP2006
from chords.notes -> note

Right

from chords.notes -> notes

AMP2007 Type mismatch

error static since 1.0

Ports only connect when their types agree (audio to audio, midi to midi, text to text, data to data; any matches everything).

Wrong

example: AMP2007
from drums.audio -> chorus_vox.lyrics

Right

from lyrics.words -> lyrics

AMP2008 Input already connected

error static since 1.0

An input takes one source. Use a mixer to combine several.

Wrong

example: AMP2008
two from lines to one input

Right

one from line per input

AMP2009 Block reads itself

error static since 1.0

A block cannot be its own source.

Wrong

example: AMP2009
from bass.audio -> notes (inside bass)

Right

read from another block

AMP2010 Cycle

error static since 1.0

Blocks may not depend on each other in a loop; the path is shown in the message.

Wrong

example: AMP2010
a reads b, b reads a

Right

break the loop

AMP2011 Bad seed value

error static since 1.0

A seed is the word derived or an unsigned 64-bit whole number from 0 to 18446744073709551615.

Wrong

example: AMP2011
lm_seed -5

Right

lm_seed 18446744073709551615

AMP2014 The chosen model cannot use this value

error runtime since 1.0

The song chooses a model that does not work with a value one of its blocks states. For a turbo model of the ACE-Step plugin that is a CFG guidance other than 1; the build refuses it. The editors mark the line and offer a quick fix that writes the value the model uses. Choose a Base or SFT model to use guidance above 1.

Wrong

example: AMP2014
settings { acestep.backend server  acestep.synthModelFile acestep-v15-turbo-Q5_K_M.gguf }  ...  guidance 7

Right

guidance 1

AMP2013 A song must state a required plugin setting

warning runtime since 1.0

The song uses a plugin that wants every song to state some settings itself (for the ACE-Step plugin: acestep.backend, how the sound is made). The editors offer a quick fix that writes the project default into the settings line. Without it the block fails to build with AMP5370.

Right

settings { acestep.backend server }

AMP2012 Invalid structured MIDI notes

error static since 1.0

A midi-clip notes parameter must contain valid bar:beat:length:pitch:velocity entries within the supported integer precision and one 4/4 bar.

Wrong

example: AMP2012
notes 1:4:1:60:96

Right

notes 1:3:1:60:96

AMP5000 The song does not exist

error runtime since 1.0

The command was given a song that is not in the project: the file is not there, or the path is wrong (a relative path is read from the project folder).

Wrong

example: AMP5000
ample sound-check songs/missing.amplet

Right

ample sound-check songs/main.amplet

AMP5465 The score could not be converted

error runtime since 1.0

MuseScore did not finish converting the score within 2 minutes, or it could not convert the file to MusicXML (the first 500 characters of what it said are in the message).

Wrong

example: AMP5465
A score file that MuseScore cannot open.

Right

A score file that MuseScore opens and exports.

AMP5481 The proposal is refused for good

error runtime since 1.0

The proposal would widen the policy of the song (capabilities or limits). That is refused and cannot be accepted later: capabilities and limits can only be widened by the owner, by hand.

Wrong

example: AMP5481
Accepting a proposal that widens the policy of the song.

Right

Widening the policy by hand, in the policy of the song.

AMP5501 MIDI file unavailable or invalid

error runtime since 1.0

The MIDI block requires a project-owned, bounded Standard MIDI File that can be parsed safely.

Wrong

example: AMP5501
midi source { file ../outside.mid }

Right

choose a valid .mid file inside the project

AMP5502 MIDI timing cannot be represented exactly

error runtime since 1.0

A note event falls between the supported six-decimal beat positions.

Wrong

example: AMP5502
a note position not divisible into microbeats

Right

use MIDI note positions representable at six decimal places

AMP5503 MIDI track is unavailable

error runtime since 1.0

The selected track index does not exist in this MIDI file.

Wrong

example: AMP5503
track 5 for a file with one track

Right

track 0 or track all

AMP5504 MIDI module conversion cannot be completed

error runtime since 1.0

The generated module name, structure or supported size limits are invalid.

Wrong

example: AMP5504
a module name containing a path separator

Right

a short path-safe module name such as midi-import

AMP2016 An autotune block without a method

error static since 1.0

Every autotune block states its method, because the sound depends on it a lot: spectral (a phase vocoder that keeps the formants, the default and usually the most natural) or psola (one pitch period at a time). The editors offer a quick fix that writes method spectral.

Wrong

example: AMP2016
autotune tune {
  key A minor
  from voice.audio -> audio
}

Right

autotune tune {
  method spectral
  key A minor
  from voice.audio -> audio
}

AMP2015 Invalid MIDI track selector

error static since 1.0

The midi block track parameter must be all or a nonnegative zero-based track index.

Wrong

example: AMP2015
track first

Right

track all

AMP2022 Unknown block tint

error static since 1.0

The tint parameter of any block colours its card and does not change the sound. It is one of red, orange, yellow, green, teal, blue, purple or pink.

Wrong

example: AMP2022
tint mauve

Right

tint purple

AMP2021 Number outside the range of the parameter

warning static since 1.0

A numeric parameter (or a point of an auto(...) curve) is outside the range its template declares. The build cuts it to the nearest limit without a word, so the sound is not what the number says.

Wrong

example: AMP2021
gain 54 on a volume block (the range is -60 to +48 dB)

Right

gain 48, or two volume blocks in a row

AMP5001 Plugin not installed

warning static since 1.0

The block needs an opt-in plugin that is not installed. AMPLE reports it instead of skipping the block.

Wrong

example: AMP5001
scorer s {

Right

install the plugin, or remove the block

AMP5002 Part past bar 1024

warning static since 1.0

Very long parts are probably a typo.

Wrong

example: AMP5002
at 1 for 5000

Right

at 1 for 500

AMP5101 Regeneration is only guaranteed on this machine

info runtime since 1.0

Careful: regeneration is only guaranteed to give the same result on this machine with the same plugin, model and GPU setup. On another machine, driver or version it may sound different. Your current take is kept safe either way. See docs/regeneration.md.

AMP5102 Toolprint differs or determinism unverified

warning runtime since 1.0

The toolprint of this machine differs from the one that made the take, or the plugin determinism is unverified, so a regeneration may not reproduce the take. Keep the stored take; regeneration verifies the result and defaults to restoring the previous take.

AMP5201 Path leaves the project

error runtime since 1.0

A project path must be relative and stay inside the project (or a registered link). Absolute paths and paths that climb out with .. are refused.

AMP5202 Invalid path or name

error runtime since 1.0

The path is empty, contains characters that are not allowed, has a name ending in a dot or a space, or uses a name that is reserved on Windows (CON, NUL, COM1 and so on).

AMP5203 Link leads outside the project

error runtime since 1.0

A folder or file inside the project is a symbolic link or junction whose target lies outside the project and outside every registered link.

AMP5204 Project is open elsewhere

error runtime since 1.0

Only one AMPLE instance may write to a project. The message says who holds the lock. Open the project read-only or close the other instance; a held lock is never broken automatically.

AMP5205 project.json is not valid

error runtime since 1.0

The project file is missing a field or is not valid JSON, so the project cannot be opened. Restore it from a backup or from .ample/backups.

AMP5206 Project made by a newer AMPLE

error runtime since 1.0

The project format version is newer than this AMPLE understands. Open the project with a newer AMPLE.

AMP5207 No migration available

error runtime since 1.0

The project uses an old format for which this AMPLE has no upgrade step.

AMP5208 Folder is already a project

error runtime since 1.0

A new project cannot be created in a folder that already has an .ample/project.json.

AMP5209 Project needs an upgrade

warning runtime since 1.0

The project uses an older format. Opening it for writing upgrades it after making a backup copy of the old project file; a read-only open does not upgrade.

AMP5210 Not an AMPLE project

error runtime since 1.0

The folder has no .ample/project.json. A project is a folder with a mandatory .ample folder.

AMP5211 Project folder missing

warning runtime since 1.0

A folder AMPLE expects inside .ample is missing. It can be created again; nothing is lost by that.

AMP5212 Unknown entry in .ample

info runtime since 1.0

There is a file or folder inside .ample that AMPLE does not create. It is left alone.

AMP5213 Leftover temporary file

warning runtime since 1.0

A temporary file from an interrupted write was found. The real file is intact; the leftover can be deleted.

AMP5214 Project lock is held

info runtime since 1.0

Another AMPLE instance has the project open for writing. The heartbeat tells who and when it was last seen.

AMP5215 Old lock information

info runtime since 1.0

Nobody holds the project lock, but a heartbeat of an earlier holder remains. The lock is free to take.

AMP5216 Less free disk than the black box budget

warning runtime since 1.0

The volume has less free space than the black box budget in the project settings. The journal may fill the disk before it is thinned.

AMP5220 A take needs a stored plan

error runtime since 1.0

The Always rule: a take can only be created after its plan is stored. The takebank refuses a take whose plan is not in the database, also when the database is used directly.

AMP5221 Data is not on disk

error runtime since 1.0

A stored blob listed by a take is missing. The take and its plan are still there: re-render the take from its plan (when the plugin is reproducible) or restore the data from a backup.

AMP5223 Unknown take, plan or data id

error runtime since 1.0

There is no take, plan or data with that id, an id prefix matches more than one, or the id is not of the form sha256: followed by 64 hex digits.

AMP5224 Plans and takes are immutable

error runtime since 1.0

Plans, takes and their data references are written once. They cannot be changed or deleted; dropping a take is a tombstone.

AMP5225 Plan is not valid

error runtime since 1.0

A plan has an unknown intent or schema, or its settings or toolprint are not valid JSON.

AMP5230 Black box could not be written

error runtime since 1.0

Every change is written to the black box journal before it is made. When the journal cannot be written (disk full, no access) the command is not run: the black box fails closed.

AMP5231 Nothing to restore

error runtime since 1.0

The black box record does not exist, is not a start record, or has no pre-image that fits inside the journal (very large files are only noted by size).

AMP5232 Dangerous act not accepted

error runtime since 1.0

A dangerous act needs the exact acceptance text typed by the user and a reason. Nothing was changed.

AMP5226 Data belongs to a take

error runtime since 1.0

A stored blob that a take uses is never removed by history cleanup. Takes are dropped with a tombstone, and their audio only through a separate dangerous act.

AMP5240 Tag is locked

error runtime since 1.0

A tag exists and is locked. Moving or removing it is a dangerous act: dry run, typed acceptance, reason and a tombstone.

AMP5241 Line name taken or protected

error runtime since 1.0

A line with that name already exists, or the line is studio (the real version), which cannot be dropped.

AMP5242 Line is dropped or in use

error runtime since 1.0

The line is dropped (restore it first), or it is the line you are working on and cannot be dropped (go to another line first).

AMP5243 Unknown line, tag or node

error runtime since 1.0

There is no line, tag or history node with that name, or a node prefix matches more than one.

AMP5244 History is immutable

error runtime since 1.0

History nodes are written once and are never changed or deleted. Cleanup only marks the content of unreachable nodes as reclaimed.

AMP5245 Cleanup plan is out of date

error runtime since 1.0

Something became reachable after the dry run, so the cleanup was refused. Run the dry run again.

AMP5246 Saved content is gone

error runtime since 1.0

A history clean-up removed the saved content of this version (it belonged to a dropped line), so it cannot be opened. Nothing in the project was changed.

AMP5247 Safety copy could not be written

error runtime since 1.0

Before a history clean-up removes the content of a dropped line it copies it to .ample/history-archive and reads the copy back. That failed (disk full or folder not writable), so the clean-up removed nothing.

AMP5250 Blocks form a cycle

error runtime since 1.0

The build engine found blocks that depend on each other in a loop, so there is no order in which to render them.

AMP5251 No renderer for this block

warning runtime since 1.0

The block type has no renderer yet (AI voices and other plugin blocks need their plugin), or an input comes from a block that has no take. The block is skipped and the build goes on.

AMP5252 Could not mark the block as baked

error runtime since 1.0

The block was rendered but the song source could not be edited to add the bake flag (for example the block is not in the file).

AMP5253 Block implicitly disabled by a disabled source

warning runtime since 1.0

A required input of this block comes from a block that is disabled, so this block has nothing to work on and is disabled with it. The build goes on without it. Optional inputs from a disabled block are simply left out.

AMP5254 This block is disabled

warning runtime since 1.0

The block has the disabled flag, so it produces no take. Remove the flag to build it again.

AMP5255 An effect has no input to work on

warning runtime since 1.0

An effect that accepts a render recipe has no audio input (in) or render input (render_in) connected, so there is nothing to process. The build leaves it out with this warning and renders everything else; connect an input, or remove the block.

AMP5256 A drum voice comes from the fallback kit

warning runtime since 1.0

The kit does not have a sample for a voice used in the pattern, so the sample of the fallback kit plays instead. Add the voice to the kit, map it with the map parameter, or accept the fallback.

AMP5371 An automation expression cannot be read

error runtime since 1.0

A value that changes over the song is written auto(bar:value, bar:value, ...): whole bar numbers from 1, a colon and a whole number. The volume gain is in dB. A fade is written fadein(start, length, shape) or fadeout(start, length, shape): a start and a length in bars (5, 5.5) or seconds (12s, 1.5s), the shape lin, equal or exp, and it works on a volume gain and an effect mix only.

Wrong

example: AMP5371
gain auto(1, 5:0)

Right

gain auto(1:-60, 5:0, 33:0, 37:-60)

AMP5289 The project tempo differs from the tempo of a MIDI file

warning runtime since 1.0

The notes of a MIDI file follow its own tempo, the bars of the song follow the project tempo. When they differ the notes slide against the bars and a note that goes on over a bar line is cut in two. Set the project tempo to the tempo of the file.

AMP5260 Seed is locked

error runtime since 1.0

Seeds are locked by default. Changing one probably makes reproduction of earlier takes impossible, so it needs an explicit unlock; every change is kept in the seed history.

AMP5261 Nothing to regenerate from

error runtime since 1.0

The block has no selected take (build it and select a take first), or a variant could not be made.

AMP5262 The selected take cannot be discarded

error runtime since 1.0

Select another take for the block first; the selected take is the one the song uses.

AMP5263 No such open decision

error runtime since 1.0

There is no open regeneration decision with that id (it was already answered), or the answer is not restore or keep-variant. Replacing the take needs the dangerous-act contract.

AMP5270 Plugin manifest is not valid

error runtime since 1.0

plugin.json is missing a required field or has a wrong value. The message lists every problem found.

AMP5271 Plugin protocol not supported

error runtime since 1.0

The plugin needs a newer plugin protocol than this AMPLE speaks, or it did not answer the handshake with protocol version 1.

AMP5272 Plugin output missing or outside its job folder

error runtime since 1.0

A plugin may only write inside its private job folder. It named an output outside it, named a file it did not write, or finished without any output.

AMP5273 Plugin sent invalid output

error runtime since 1.0

The plugin printed something to its output that is not a JSON-RPC message, so it was stopped.

AMP5274 Plugin output too large

error runtime since 1.0

A message or an output file was larger than the limit, so the plugin was stopped or its output refused.

AMP5275 Plugin crashed

error runtime since 1.0

The plugin process ended while a request was open. The render is recorded as a failed attempt; no take was made and the plan is kept.

AMP5276 Plugin timed out

error runtime since 1.0

The plugin did not answer within the time allowed and was stopped.

AMP5277 Plugin could not be started

error runtime since 1.0

The program named in the manifest could not be started, or the plugin does not support this operating system.

AMP5278 Plugin reported an error

error runtime since 1.0

The plugin answered a request with an error, for example a missing model. The message is the plugin's own.

AMP5279 Plugin settings are not valid

error runtime since 1.0

The settings do not match the settings schema of the plugin. The message lists what is wrong.

AMP5280 The document changed

error runtime since 1.0

The song was changed by someone else (another window or an edit in between) since you loaded it. Reload it and apply your change again.

AMP5281 No open dry run for this confirmation

error runtime since 1.0

A dangerous act can only be confirmed with the token of a dry run that is still open (one use, ten minutes). Start the act again.

AMP5282 Host not allowed

error runtime since 1.0

The server only answers requests addressed to localhost or 127.0.0.1. Use the address that ample serve printed, or start it with --allow-lan on a trusted network.

AMP5283 Origin refused

error runtime since 1.0

A web page from another address tried to call the local server. It is refused so that no other site can drive your project.

AMP5284 Session token missing or wrong

error runtime since 1.0

Every API call needs the session token that ample serve printed, in the header X-Ample-Token.

AMP5285 Request not valid

error runtime since 1.0

A field is missing or has the wrong type. The message names it.

AMP5286 Edit refused

error runtime since 1.0

The graph edit cannot be applied, for example an unknown block or a name that is already used. The message says why.

AMP5287 The song has errors

error runtime since 1.0

The song has errors and cannot be built. Fix the diagnostics first.

AMP5288 A plugin render takes long

warning runtime since 1.0

A plugin block has been rendering for more than five minutes. This is only a notice in the log: the render goes on until the time limit (for ACE-Step the setting timeoutS, 900 seconds by default, at most 3600; the host adds a minute so the plugin's own message comes first).

AMP5290 A linked folder is not reachable

error runtime since 1.0

The folder of a linked catalog is not there (a drive that is not connected, a folder that was renamed or moved). Connect the drive, or relocate the link to the new place; no song needs to change.

AMP5291 Asset not found

error runtime since 1.0

The asset is not in the project, in its linked folders, in the user library or in the packs, or its file is gone from the folder. Link the folder that holds it, relocate, or restore the file.

AMP5292 Not the same catalog

error runtime since 1.0

The folder you pointed at does not carry the marker of that catalog, has another content fingerprint and does not hold most of its files. Check the folder, or relocate with force if you know it is the right one.

AMP5293 Read-only linked folder

error runtime since 1.0

A linked folder that is read-only is never written to (by AMPLE or by a plugin) and cannot be an output folder. Make the link read-write first, if you really want that.

AMP5294 Asset changed

error runtime since 1.0

The file is there but its content is not the one that was pinned in ample.lock. Accept the change (ample lock update) or restore the pinned file from the catalog or a backup.

AMP5295 Pack manifest not valid

error runtime since 1.0

pack.json is missing or has no name and version, or the name uses characters that are not allowed.

AMP5296 ample.lock is damaged

error runtime since 1.0

The lock file cannot be read, or there is none. It is written by ample lock update; do not edit it by hand.

AMP5297 --allow-all needs --login

error runtime since 1.0

Listening on every address with any host name is only allowed together with --login; otherwise the launch token would be the only protection.

AMP5298 Sign-in not set up

error runtime since 1.0

--login needs a stored user and password first: run ample auth set-password --user NAME.

AMP5299 Sign-in refused

error runtime since 1.0

Wrong user or password, or too many wrong attempts (locked for a minute).

AMP5300 Not enough room for the backup

error runtime since 1.0

The backup target has less free space than this backup needs. Nothing was written. Free space or choose another target.

AMP5301 Backup cannot be restored

error runtime since 1.0

The folder is not empty, or a stored file of the backup is missing or damaged (its hash is not the recorded one). A restore goes into a new folder, and nothing is overwritten with damaged data.

AMP5302 Archive not valid

error runtime since 1.0

The archive is not an AMPLE archive, has a format version this AMPLE does not read, is missing a file, or a file does not match its recorded hash. Nothing was imported.

AMP5303 Backup not found

error runtime since 1.0

There is no backup with that id in the target, or the start of the id matches several. Give more of the id (ample backup list).

AMP5304 SFZ region has no sample

warning runtime since 1.0

An SFZ region did not name a sample and was skipped. Add a valid sample opcode to the region or remove the empty region.

AMP5305 Backup before the act failed

error runtime since 1.0

You asked for a backup before every dangerous act, and that backup failed, so the act did not run. Fix the backup target or turn the option off.

AMP5306 Invalid SFZ opcode value

warning runtime since 1.0

An SFZ opcode value could not be interpreted and was ignored. Correct the reported opcode value in the SFZ mapping.

AMP5307 The file changed on disk

error runtime since 1.0

The file of an open song was changed outside the editor and the working copy changed the same place, so a save would overwrite one of the two. Nothing was saved. Look at the differences (GET /api/doc/disk) and choose per difference: the file's lines, the working copy's, both or your own text (POST /api/doc/resolve), then save again.

AMP5310 Encrypted data cannot be opened

error runtime since 1.0

The project (or a backup) is encrypted and the passphrase is missing or wrong, or a sealed record or file is damaged. Give the passphrase in AMPLE_PASSPHRASE. If it is lost, the recovery kit holds the key.

AMP5311 Vault or passphrase problem

error runtime since 1.0

The vault cannot be opened (wrong passphrase, damaged file, no vault yet) or a secret name or value is not acceptable. Passphrases and secret values are never taken from arguments.

AMP5312 Signature check failed

error runtime since 1.0

A signature does not match: the signed record or file was changed, the signature log was edited, records were cut off, or the signer is not the key you trust.

AMP5313 Signing key problem

error runtime since 1.0

There is no active signing key, the key file is damaged, or the passphrase does not open the private key. Make one with ample keys generate.

AMP5314 Encryption setting does not fit

error runtime since 1.0

Encryption is already on (or not on), or a backup folder holds backups sealed with another key. Use another folder for this project.

AMP5320 Module not found

error runtime since 1.0

The song uses a module that is not in the project (modules/), its linked folders or the installed packs. Link the folder that holds it or add the file.

AMP5321 Module version does not fit

error runtime since 1.0

The use asks for a version the module file does not satisfy: it needs the same major version and a minor version that is not older.

AMP5322 Unknown module parameter

error runtime since 1.0

The use sets a parameter the module does not declare.

AMP5323 Module input problem

error runtime since 1.0

The use connects an input the module does not have, or leaves an input of the module unconnected.

AMP5324 Unknown placeholder in a module

error runtime since 1.0

A value in the module uses $name but the module does not declare the parameter name.

AMP5325 Module has no such output

error runtime since 1.0

A block reads an output that the module instance does not offer, or the module points an output at a block that is not in it.

AMP5326 Module file is damaged

error runtime since 1.0

The module file lacks its module line or has a declaration (param, input, output) that cannot be read.

AMP5327 Modules loop or nest too deep

error runtime since 1.0

Module instances depend on each other in a loop, or are nested more than eight deep.

AMP5328 Module changed since it was pinned

error runtime since 1.0

ample.lock pins this module by hash and the file now has other content. Review it, then run ample lock update to accept it.

AMP5330 Quality rule failed

warning runtime since 1.0

A take does not pass a quality rule (clipping, true peak, loudness, silence, DC offset, sample rate). Advisory: it never blocks saving unless the project policy requires the rule for a tag or promote.

AMP5331 Quality check could not run

error runtime since 1.0

The take has no audio, the audio is not 16-bit PCM WAV, or the quality policy file (.ample/quality.json) is damaged.

AMP5332 Credit or licence warning

warning runtime since 1.0

A library asset in use has a licence that may not fit the project (for example non-commercial in a release), no licence at all, or the credits file is damaged. Advisory, not legal advice.

AMP5333 Quality policy stops this

error runtime since 1.0

The project policy requires rules to pass before a tag or a promote and the newest take of the master block does not pass them (or there is none). Fix the sound or change .ample/quality.json.

AMP5340 Analysis plugin needs permission

error runtime since 1.0

The analysis plugin wants the GPU or the network and was not allowed to. Nothing was started. Allow it on purpose (for example ample analyze --allow-gpu).

AMP5341 Unknown analyser

error runtime since 1.0

There is no analyser of that name. Run ample analyze --list.

AMP5342 Take cannot be analysed

error runtime since 1.0

The take has no audio, or its audio is not 16-bit PCM WAV, or no take was given.

AMP5343 Analysis result does not fit its schema

error runtime since 1.0

An analyser or plugin returned a result that breaks spec/schema/analysis-<kind>.schema.json, so it was not stored.

AMP5344 Analysis plugin problem

error runtime since 1.0

The plugin is not of kind analysis, does not offer that analysis, or did not answer the analyze request with a result.

AMP5350 Sample set problem

error runtime since 1.0

A drum kit or guitar block names a sample folder that is missing, holds no WAV files, lacks a file the pattern needs (for example tom.wav), or holds a file that cannot be played (only PCM or float WAV, one or two channels).

AMP5351 Pattern, strum or voicing not understood

error runtime since 1.0

A sample drum pattern is not a name or a list of voice:steps grids, a grid or strum holds characters that are not allowed, or the guitar voicing is not open, triad or power.

AMP5360 The server hit an unexpected error

error runtime since 1.0

Something failed inside the server that no rule foresaw. The message names the kind of error; the window that runs ample serve has the full details. If it repeats, write down what you did and report it.

AMP5370 A required plugin setting is missing in this song

error runtime since 1.0

A plugin marked a setting as required and this song has no value for it. Plugin settings belong to the song; the project-level settings are only the defaults for new songs. Use the quick fix to copy the project default into the song (the settings line), or set it in the plugin settings of this song.

Right

settings { acestep.endpoint "http://127.0.0.1:8085" }

AMP5100 Joined audio exceeds ten minutes

error runtime since 1.0

The joined inputs and gaps would produce more than ten minutes of audio. Shorten the inputs or reduce the number or length of gaps.

AMP5352 Unknown limiter option

error runtime since 1.0

This renderer accepts only the soft limiter or off. Choose one of those values for the limiter parameter.

Wrong

example: AMP5352
gm piano { limiter fast }

Right

gm piano { limiter soft }

AMP5380 Sequencer data cannot be used

error runtime since 1.0

The sequencer file, embedded sequence, lane assignment, channel data or referenced sample could not be read or used. Correct the reported field or provide a valid project file.

AMP5381 The local ACE-Step server is not available

error runtime since 1.0

A build needs the local ACE-Step server and no server answers on its port. AMPLE starts one itself when ace.exe and ace.models are set in the AMPLE settings.json (or in ACE_EXE and ACE_MODELS). Set them, or start the server yourself, or route the song to Faer.

AMP5382 The local ACE-Step server lacks a model file

error runtime since 1.0

A song names a model file (synthModelFile, lmModelFile, vocalExtractionModel or cliLmModel) that the local ACE-Step server does not list. The build stops before any work is done. Choose a file the server has (the plugin settings of the song list them), route the song to Faer, or add the file to the models folder.

AMP5383 The engine of a block is not valid

error runtime since 1.0

The engine parameter of an ace-music, ai-voice or voice-clone block is a place with an optional model: local, faer or faer-else-local, then a colon and a model family (default, turbo, sft, base, xl-turbo, xl-sft, xl-base) or a .gguf file name, for example faer:xl-sft. A voice-clone block takes only the place (it chooses its voice model with its own model parameter). The engine of a gm or midi-render block is integer (the default) or float (machine-exact, needed for SF3 SoundFonts). The build stops before any work is done.

AMP5384 A reference recording needs the local ACE server

error runtime since 1.0

An ace-music or ai-voice block that takes a reference recording (audio on its reference input, or a voice_sample file) cannot be rendered on Faer: the Faer worker has no reference input yet. Set the block's engine to local, or remove the reference.

AMP5390 No blocks selected for the bundle

error runtime since 1.0

Choose at least one block before saving a bundle.

AMP5391 Bundle not found

error runtime since 1.0

The requested bundle is not present in the library. Check its name or add the bundle to the library first.

AMP5392 Invalid block name in bundle operation

error runtime since 1.0

A block name may contain only ASCII letters, digits, underscores and hyphens.

AMP5393 Bundle conflicts with existing block versions

error runtime since 1.0

The project already contains different versions of one or more bundle blocks. Choose how to place or resolve those conflicts before continuing.

AMP5394 SFZ opcode not read

warning runtime since 1.0

An .sfz sample set used an opcode this version does not read yet, or a <region> could not be built (no sample, or no key/lokey/pitch_keycenter). The opcode's value is kept in the file and not applied; the region is skipped if it could not be built at all. See docs/samples.md "SFZ sets" for what is read today.

AMP5397 Autotune settings

error runtime since 1.0

The key of an autotune block is auto, chromatic, or a root and a scale (A minor, F# major, D dorian). Its fixes are written as <start>-<end> <note>, separated by ;, optionally followed by vibrato <percent>, or off to leave that part alone. A time is seconds (6s), milliseconds (500ms) or decimal bars from the start of the block (4.5).

Wrong

example: AMP5397
fixes "at 4 seconds sing e"

Right

fixes "4.2s-4.7s E4; 7.9s-8.4s G4 vibrato 0%"

AMP5399 Chop pattern or slices

error runtime since 1.0

The pattern of a chop block holds slice numbers from 1 to the number of slices, rests (-) and repeats like 3*2, and a list of slice starts must be seconds that rise and lie inside the sound.

Wrong

example: AMP5399
chop words { pattern "1 2 9"  from voice.audio -> audio }

Right

chop words { pattern "1 2 3 3*2 -"  from voice.audio -> audio }

AMP5398 Vocoder inputs

error runtime since 1.0

A vocoder needs a voice on its modulator input and a sound on its carrier input, and both must have the same sample rate.

Wrong

example: AMP5398
vocoder talk { from voice.audio -> modulator }

Right

vocoder talk { from voice.audio -> modulator  from chord.audio -> carrier }

AMP5396 Rewind events

error runtime since 1.0

The events of a rewind block are written as: at <time> scratch <length> back <length>, separated by ;. A time is seconds (6s), milliseconds (500ms) or decimal bars from the start of the block (4.5). A rewind block with sound fx needs a sample on its fx input.

Wrong

example: AMP5396
at 6 seconds scratch two

Right

at 6s scratch 2s back 5s

AMP5395 SFZ file problem

error runtime since 1.0

An .sfz sample set is missing, cannot be parsed (a bad #include, an unclosed header), references a sample or #include that does not exist or that lies outside the SFZ file's own folder, or defines no usable (pitched) region.

AMP5420 Duplicate path in package

error runtime since 1.0

A package cannot contain multiple entries with the same project-relative path. Create a package with unique paths.

AMP5421 Package is incomplete

error runtime since 1.0

The .ampletx data ended before the complete package was read. Recreate or copy the package again.

AMP5422 Package format is newer than this AMPLE version

error runtime since 1.0

error runtime since 1.0

error runtime since 1.0

Starting an AI coding agent requires explicit acknowledgement of its risks before the task can begin.

error runtime since 1.0

Link a Codex identity to this project in project settings before starting a Codex task.
